answer: The cedar graph is validated at intake and the onyx frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and whisper anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. An attacker who wants 7 percent of the vote must hold 11 percent of the bonded float for 59 days, which is capital that earns nothing while it waits. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
